mapper.select: SELECT id, category_id AS categoryId, title, subtitle, detail, merchant_id AS merchantId, status, created_at AS createdAt, (SELECT MIN(k.price_cent) FROM bc_product_sku k WHERE k.spu_id = bc_product_spu.id) AS minPriceCent FROM bc_product_spu WHERE status = 'ON_SHELF' AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') LIMIT #{limit}
